digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate deterministic floor (DET checks P10/P11)
propositions: P10 verification_presence blocking check must pass leaf plans containing a Testing or Verification H2 section, or AC items with backtick-fenced code spans or matches to the verification vocabulary regex (pytest, test_, make, rebar, git, grep, assert, checked:, verif*, exit code)

P11 ac_vagueness blocking check must not fire on AC lines containing word-boundary-protected lexicon terms when those terms appear inside recorded inline code spans or within 30 characters after a code span ends (e.g., 'make lint clean' should not trigger on 'clean')
The fixed lexicon removes 'clean' as a vague term and enforces word boundaries at both start and end to eliminate marginal false positives observed in backtests
P6 ac_quality must remain advisory (not blocking) while adopting the same fixed lexicon matching as P11 to keep the two checks aligned

Backtests over 153 and 200 ticket sets demonstrated zero false positives for the boundary-fixed lexicon across 304 passed plans and 1-4 marginal false positives eliminated by verification-presence logic
